term: valid moral modus ponens in the Frege–Geach comparison
definition: For p, q and the conditional if p then q, validity requires that p have the same meaning in its free-standing occurrence and in the conditional’s antecedent. Geach’s cat/little-brother example is the instance at issue. In Lean ValidMP p q is primitive; the constant-meaning requirement is an explicit necessary-condition premise, not a definition of validity or a proof that constant meaning suffices for validity. A joint model satisfying ValidMP is a consistency witness, not its explanation.
